name: rd.z
role: read, zeros: the control of every flat-out read

name: rd.w1
role: read, one bit a line: what a line that is not all zeros adds

name: rd.u2
role: read, every byte 0x03: 128 ones, 128 high pins a line

name: rd.u4
role: read, every byte 0x0F: 256 ones, 256 high pins

name: rd.u7
role: read, every byte 0x7F: 448 ones, 128 high pins (inverted)

name: rd.u8
role: read, every byte 0xFF: 512 ones, 64 high pins (inverted)

name: rd.l08
role: read, byte lanes constant 0x00 and 0xFF: 256 ones, 32 high pins, no toggle

name: rd.a44
role: read, beats alternate 0x0F/0xF0: 256 ones, 256 high, 512 pin toggles

name: rd.rnd
role: read, random lines

name: wr.z
role: write, zeros: the control of every flat-out write

name: wr.w1
role: write, one bit a line

name: wr.u2
role: write, every byte 0x03

name: wr.u4
role: write, every byte 0x0F

name: wr.u7
role: write, every byte 0x7F

name: wr.u8
role: write, every byte 0xFF: 512 ones, 64 high pins if inverted, 512 if not

name: wr.l08
role: write, byte lanes constant 0x00 and 0xFF: 256 ones, no pin toggle

name: wr.a08
role: write, beats 0x0000/0xFFFF: l08's ones and pins, 64 toggles inverted, 512 not

name: wr.a44
role: write, beats alternate 0x0F/0xF0: 512 pin toggles either way

name: wr.p64
role: write, 8-byte pieces alternate 0x0F/0xF0

name: wr.h256
role: write, the line's 32 B halves 0x0F and 0xF0

name: wr.c44
role: write, whole lines 0x0F or 0xF0 by minion parity: a channel's lines change

name: wr.rnd
role: write, random lines (each minion its own 512 B)

name: rdh.z
role: paced read, zeros

name: rdh.u4
role: paced read, every byte 0x0F

name: rdh.rnd
role: paced read, random lines

name: rdh.l1
role: paced read loop on one L1 line: no memory traffic

name: wrh.z
role: paced write, zeros

name: wrh.u4
role: paced write, every byte 0x0F

name: wrh.rnd
role: paced write, random lines

name: wrh.scp
role: paced write loop into the own scratchpad: no DRAM traffic

name: wrh.nst
role: paced write loop with no store at all: no traffic
